# Version 4.152.0
> **Skia m152 release candidate** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews the Chrome m152 renderer and its upstream stability fixes. This release candidate also updates HarfBuzzSharp and continues platform and runtime compatibility improvements.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated for Chrome m152** — Updates the bundled renderer with the Chrome m152 upstream fix set. ([#4803](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4803))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

Updates HarfBuzzSharp for the 4.152 release line and refreshes its bundled native dependency.
